susolisting: 'Shiny' Application for Enumeration Area Listing on Satellite Imagery

Source: R/susolisting-package.R
susolisting-package.Rd

Interactive 'Shiny' application to mark buildings on 'Google Maps' or 'Vantor' ('Maxar') satellite imagery within user-provided enumeration area (EA) boundaries. Reads boundary polygons in 'ESRI' shapefile format, exports listed building coordinates as a CSV file, supports second-stage spatially balanced sampling via 'spsurvey', and integrates with 'Survey Solutions' (https://mysurvey.solutions/) via 'SurveySolutionsAPIv2' for automated survey assignment creation.
